tools.name: run_account_reconciliation_script
tools.description: Runs the reconciliation script for a bank account over a date range and returns the count of matched and unmatched transactions from the ledger.
tools.code:
import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess

DB = "/var/data/bank/ledger.db"
SCRIPT = "/opt/bank/scripts/reconcile.py"


def run_account_reconciliation_script(account_id: str, start: str, end: str) -> dict:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE account_id = ? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?", (account_id, start, end))
    n = cur.fetchone()[0]
    cur.execute("SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    con.close()
    if row is None:
        return {"error": "account not found"}
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", SCRIPT, "--account", account_id, "--from", start, "--to", end],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return {"error": p.stderr.strip()[:500], "transactions": n}
    out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    return {"transactions": n, "matched": out.get("matched", 0), "unmatched": out.get("unmatched", 0)}

tools.name: trigger_statement_export_job
tools.description: Starts a statement generation job for an account and month, and posts the job request to the external statement delivery service.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Account to generate the statement for

tools.code:
import os
import requests

BASE = os.environ.get("STATEMENT_SERVICE_URL", "https://statements.example-bank.com")
TOKEN = os.environ.get("STATEMENT_SERVICE_TOKEN", "")


def trigger_statement_export_job(account_id: str, month: str) -> dict:
    with requests.Session() as s:
        s.headers.update({"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"})
        r = s.post(
            f"{BASE}/v1/jobs",
            json={"account_id": account_id, "month": month, "format": "pdf"},
            timeout=30,
        )
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()
